title: Foundit Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, location, years of experience, skills, pay when shown, first-listed date, country site, listing source and job link, and with details on the description, every place with its state, the qualifications and pay as numbers. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: country sites read, sites and companies with a match, jobs matched and saved, checked links, sites that could not be read, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
